import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    w = 0.22
    s = np.sin(w*t); c = np.cos(w*t)
    return (params[0]*P + params[1]*P**2 + params[2]*P**3 + params[3]*P**4
            + params[4] + params[5]*t + (params[6] + params[7]*P)*s + params[8]*c + params[9]*P*c)
